scope_statement: 80 feature families for an expanded free/open-source iPhone Atlas roadmap. A bounded primary-source landscape, not an exhaustive benchmark or complete parity claim.
compatibility_statement: No competitor was installed or benchmarked and no physical iPhone test was performed for this matrix. Source-documented availability is not Atlas support.

phases.P0: Proof work, fixture vertical slice, capability experiments and schema contracts; not public feature completion.
phases.P1: First full read-only beta: device/apps, File Sharing reads, unencrypted and known-password encrypted backups, generic viewers, Messages/Contacts and verified exports.
phases.P2: Richer decoders/imports, media organization, comparable history and evidence-driven analysis.
phases.P3: Separately validated writes, backup creation, scheduling and reversible host workflows.
phases.P4: Conditional companion, account, developer, managed-device and recovery/firmware lanes.
phases.PARKED: Desired capability recorded; no justified universal route or unsuitable promise. Preserve supported user handoffs where possible.

gates.G-FIXTURE: Versioned synthetic fixtures; bounded parsing; malformed/partial inputs; immutable source; measurable coverage.
gates.G-LIVE: Pinned adapter and an explicitly selected, authorized test device; model/iOS/build/transport matrix; denied, locked, disconnect and missing-field outcomes.
gates.G-EXPORT: Exact selection, resource grouping, destination-space/conflict handling, verified bytes or meaningful record counts, provenance and per-item receipt.
gates.G-WRITE: Per-operation capability proof and exact target; preflight and preview; explicit action confirmation; interruption semantics; no blind retry; postcondition verification.
gates.G-CRYPTO: Known user-supplied password; reviewed cryptographic implementation and test vectors; no password logs; bounded attempts and plaintext lifetime; wrong-password state.
gates.G-ACCOUNT: Supported account interface, access approval where needed, user consent and scoped tokens; no automatic credential or identifier upload.
gates.G-COMPANION: Separate signed iPhone app, entitlements, distribution and regional eligibility; revocation, stale data and production-device tests.
gates.G-RECOVERY: Sacrificial authorized device and recovery procedure; model/build/signing preflight; refusal of silent erase fallback; independently verified backup and restore results.
gates.G-MANUAL: User-supplied evidence with source/date; never overwrite measured values or imply automated validation.
gates.G-NO-ROUTE: Keep recorded as desired but unavailable; no runnable control or success simulation until a justified route and revised gate exist.
gates.G-OSS: Pinned dependencies, redistribution obligations and notices reviewed; fixture rights; reproducible build, accessibility and offline behavior checked.
gates.G-REVIEW: Versioned interpretation and source coverage; distinguish observation, inference, uncertainty and user notes; no unqualified diagnostic verdict.

features.title: Password, Activation Lock or DRM bypass promises

competitor_evidence.scope: Reincubate advertises Screen Time passcode reset and 3uTools advertises app downloads without Apple ID. This row does NOT assert either advertises Activation Lock or DRM bypass.
Reincubate advertises Screen Time passcode reset and 3uTools advertises app downloads without Apple ID. This row does NOT assert either advertises Activation Lock or DRM bypass.

features.candidate_route: No bypass feature; known-password backup access and legitimate signed-package workflows only.
features.boundary: Vendor passcode/reset or no-Apple-ID marketing is not evidence of a supported Atlas bypass.
features.acceptance_criteria: No credential guessing, lock bypass or paid-content unlocking in the deliverable; supported recovery links remain clear.
features.fallback: Apple owner recovery, known backup password, legitimate purchases and app authorization.

features.title: Battery repair, all-cache cleanup and authenticity verdicts

competitor_evidence.scope: 3uTools advertises verification and a battery-repair tool. Universal cache clearing and guaranteed physical repair/authenticity are broader user aspirations, not established vendor facts.

features.candidate_route: Keep exact desired outcomes as research questions; use validated readings and user-guided maintenance.
features.boundary: No established software route to repair physical capacity, remove all caches or certify every part.
features.acceptance_criteria: No repair/clean-all/original-device success badge; report only observed values and performed actions.
features.fallback: Battery service guidance, app-specific storage controls and documented user hardware checks.
features.competitive_scope_note: 3uTools advertises verification and a battery-repair tool. Universal cache clearing and guaranteed physical repair/authenticity are broader user aspirations, not established vendor facts.

features.title: Provenance and capability coverage everywhere

features.title: Operation planner, preservation receipts and outcome audit
